state.query: How do I validate a JWT signature step by step?

passage.title: 10.4 Header Parameter Names Registration
passage.text: This section registers specific Claim Names defined in Section 4.1 in the IANA "JSON Web Signature and Encryption Header Parameters" registry established by [JWS] for use by claims replicated as Header Parameters in JWEs, per Section 5.3.
